blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — State-run National Power Corp. (Napocor) hopes to secure regulatory approval to collect P10.82 billion from on-grid electricity consumers to support service to additional remote areas through new power providers. In its filing with the Energy Regulatory Commission (ERC), the state-run company seeks an additional P0.0939 per kilowatt-hour (kWh) in the universal charge for […]...
